newsitem.title: USA: San Jose, Calif., OKs $700 mln airport expansion.
newsitem.headline: San Jose, Calif., OKs $700 mln airport expansion.

text.p: City officials have approved a $700 million plan to expand the San Jose International Airport to handle more passenger and cargo flights in California's booming Silicon Valley, an airport spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
The San Jose City Council voted 9-to-1 to approve the plan, which was scaled back slightly from last year's $809 million expansion proposal.

The council's $700 million plan will provide funding to lengthen the main commercial runway, extend another runway to handle commercial flights and fund other developments to help the airport meet projected passenger and cargo growth.

Cathy Gaskell, an airport spokeswoman, said funding would come from federal grants, airport revenues such as landing and other user fees, and revenue bonds. General tax money would not be used, she said.
